$comment: Per-advisory, time-boxed exemptions for `npm audit`, consumed by
scripts/dependency-audit-gate.mjs. This is NOT a blanket ignore: the
gate fails on any high/critical advisory that is absent from this file,
and on any entry whose expiresOn date has passed. Removing an entry
therefore makes CI stricter, never looser.
Each entry records the advisory URL, the concrete reason the finding is
accepted today, and the date after which it must be re-triaged. See
DEPENDENCY_REMEDIATION.md for the migration plan behind each one.

exceptions.reason: Vitest UI server arbitrary file read. Vitest only runs under `npm run test`/`test:watch`; the `test:ui` script that would start the UI server was removed on this branch, `@vitest/ui` is an optional peer and is not installed, and the UI server is never started by CI or by the production build. Nothing from Vitest ships in dist/.
Vitest mock-module path traversal. Dev-only test runtime; requires a crafted mock module path that only a contributor with repo write access could introduce.
exceptions.remediation: Same vitest 2.x -> 5.x major upgrade as GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp.

exceptions.reason: vite server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate paths (\??\ and 8.3 short names). The Vite dev server is not deployed; production serves the static dist/ tree through nginx with no Vite server process. Fix requires vite 5.x -> 6.x, a major bump.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade vite 5.x -> 6.x (semver major) and re-run `npm run build`.

exceptions.reason: Path traversal in optimized-dependency .map handling. Same dev-server-only reachability as GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff; the optimized-deps cache exists only while `vite dev` is running.
exceptions.remediation: Resolved by the vite 5.x -> 6.x major upgrade.

exceptions.reason: launch-editor NTLMv2 hash disclosure via UNC path. Requires a remote page to reach the dev server's /__open-in-editor endpoint, which only exists on a contributor's localhost and is never exposed.
exceptions.remediation: Resolved by the vite 5.x -> 6.x major upgrade.

exceptions.reason: esbuild dev-server request forgery. esbuild is a build-time transform dependency; the dev server it protects against is not deployed. Bundled into the app is only esbuild's transform output, never its server.
exceptions.remediation: Resolved by the vite 5.x -> 6.x major upgrade, which pulls esbuild >= 0.25.

exceptions.reason: React Router constructor injection via deserializeErrors() during SSR hydration. Archava is a client-only SPA built with Vite: there is no server render pass, so deserializeErrors() is never called. Requires react-router 6.x -> 7.x, a major bump.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade react-router-dom 6.x -> 7.x (semver major). React Router 7 is backwards compatible for the declarative <BrowserRouter>/<Routes> API this app uses.

exceptions.reason: React Router open redirect via backslash-prefixed target in <Link>/useNavigate. In a client-only SPA a backslash target stays an in-app route; there is no cross-origin navigation. The one path that forwards an externally supplied location is the AI avatar's navigate packet, which is constrained by the ROUTE_ALIASES allowlist in src/components/ai_avatar/AvatarVoiceAgent.jsx.
exceptions.remediation: Resolved by the react-router-dom 6.x -> 7.x major upgrade; additionally keep the ROUTE_ALIASES allowlist in the avatar data handler.

exceptions.reason: decode-uri-component DoS via exponential decoding of malformed percent-encoded input. Transitive through wagmi/query-string; only reachable from a URL the visitor's own browser decodes, so the impact is confined to that visitor's tab.
exceptions.remediation: Resolved by the wagmi 2.x -> 3.x major upgrade.

exceptions.reason: uuid buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when an explicit buf is supplied. The app calls uuidv4()/randomUUID() without a caller-provided buffer, so the unchecked branch is unreachable from application code.
exceptions.remediation: Resolved by the wagmi 2.x -> 3.x major upgrade.

exceptions.reason: ws memory-exhaustion DoS from tiny fragments and data chunks. Reached only through the WalletConnect relay socket, i.e. the browser must be paired with a wallet that is itself talking to a malicious relay. Fixed in ws 8.21.0; the pinned version comes from wagmi 2.x and cannot be overridden without a major bump of wagmi.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade wagmi 2.x -> 3.x (semver major), which depends on ws >= 8.21.0.

exceptions.reason: ws uninitialized memory disclosure. Same WalletConnect-relay reachability as GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p and the same wagmi 2.x version pin.
exceptions.remediation: Resolved by the wagmi 2.x -> 3.x major upgrade.
